name: Expelled!
source:
1922. Miss Mulligatawney's School for Promising Girls is one of the best boarding schools in England. You are Verity Amersham, here on a scholarship - and today you're going to be expelled for attempted murder.

Can you escape expulsion through fair means - or foul? Can you find the culprit - or someone else to take the blame?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2963890]Steam[/url]]
translation:
1922年。穆利加托尼小姐女子英才学校是英格兰最好的寄宿学校之一。你叫维丽蒂·阿默舍姆，靠奖学金在这里读书——而今天，你要因为谋杀未遂被开除了。

光明正大也好，不择手段也好，你能躲过开除的处分吗？你能找到真凶吗？还是找个别人来背锅？

［摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2963890]Steam[/url]］
